title: Watch your Nyborg play, right in the app
author: Blitzwing /nyborg
body: Matches now play inside the Nyborg app. A little yellow 'you' pill floats over your Nyborg, and a live board shows the standings or each tank's health.

When it's over, a finish card says who won and how your Nyborg did, with buttons to go again, try a new seed, tweak your Nyborg, change the lineup, or copy a link that shows anyone the exact same match.
next: Editing your Nyborg inside the app.
